name: Gl1_L3Geom
description:
Render L3Geom geometry.

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_L3Geom.axesLabels(=false)

	Whether to display labels for local axes (x,y,z)

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_L3Geom.axesScale(=1.)

	Scale local axes, their reference length being half of the minimum radius.

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_L3Geom.axesWd(=1.)

	Width of axes lines, in pixels; not drawn if non-positive

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_L3Geom.uPhiWd(=2.)

	Width of lines for drawing displacements (and rotations for L6Geom); not drawn if non-positive.

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_L3Geom.uScale(=1.)

	Scale local displacements (u<L3Geom.u> - u0<L3Geom.u0>); 1 means the true scale, 0 disables drawing local displacements; negative values are permissible.
